in_sanskrit.name: Arjuna
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Arjuna in Sanskrit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'arjuna', which means 'bright', 'clear', 'radiant', or 'white'. In Hindu mythology, Arjuna is a central character in the Mahabharata, and is considered to be one of the greatest warriors of all time.

in_marathi.name: Arjunan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bold, Brave, Arrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Arjunan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Arjuna, the name of a legendary warrior in Hindu mythology. Derived from the Sanskrit word arjuna, meaning 'bright, bold, or shining.' Arjuna was the greatest warrior of the Mahabharata war, known for his bravery, devotion, and wisdom. He was guided by Lord Krishna, who imparted the Bhagavad Gita teachings, making Arjuna an embodiment of righteousness and the pursuit of duty over desire.
